items.title: Why Palo Alto Networks could benefit from rising cyber threats
items.summary:
Palo Alto Networks (PANW) topped Wall Street's Q1 earnings expectations and raised its full-year outlook amid growing demand for cybersecurity solutions. Following a series of high-profile technology outages, businesses are reassessing their digital vulnerabilities and investing in protections.

"The 8:30" hosts Julie Hyman, Pras Subramanian, and Jake Conley discuss what's fueling demand for cybersecurity and whether the heightened threat environment could drive further growth for Palo Alto Networks.

items.title: Palo Alto Networks (PANW) CEO Warns AI Cyberattacks Are Causing Widespread Outages
items.summary: Palo Alto Networks (NasdaqGS:PANW) CEO warned this week that AI-driven cyberattacks are triggering widespread network outages across multiple sectors. Management highlighted rising operational strain on enterprises as AI tools automate intrusion attempts and amplify the scale of disruptions. The firm pointed to its own AI-focused security upgrades as a key part of how customers are trying to contain these attacks.
